name: New York Zoo

categories.label: Zoo board fully covered
categories.hint: First player to cover every construction space with Enclosures and Attractions wins.

categories.label: Free construction spaces left
categories.hint: Fewer is better; ranks players when several finish in the same Breeding.

categories.label: Animals on board (houses + Enclosures)
categories.hint: Tiebreaker when free spaces are equal.

tiebreakers.description: Fewer free spaces in the construction area ranks higher.
More animals wins; still tied means shared win.

winCondition: First player to completely cover their construction area wins. If the game ends with the active player's main action, that player wins and no Breeding happens. If it ends through Animal Breeding, several players may finish; the one with more animals wins (tie = several winners). Other positions: fewer free spaces, then more animals.

endCondition.description: A player covers all construction spaces of their zoo board.

notes: family: race-to-goal. No points in multiplayer. Solo mode in new-york-zoo--solo.json.
